comment: task p34-machines-bumblelyzer-crucible — the RM.CrystallisationCrucible row stock (Loader_Recipes_Other.java:683-706 verbatim): the six-noble-gas loop x the Si/Ge/RedstoneAlloy/NikolineAlloy boule quartet (:683-690) + the Al2O3->Sapphire pair (:692-693) + the coloured-sapphire dopant walk (:695-706). Fluid amounts are the upstream material-amount legs resolved to mB: the gases ride the createGas 1000 mB/unit default (gas(U) = 1000 L), the molten legs the createMolten L=144 mB/unit convention (35*U9 = 35/9 x 144 = 560; 29*U9 = 464; 10*U3 = 480; full-unit legs x9/x3 scaled). The dopant-dust material AMOUNT faces (2*U3 vs 2*U) are the JSON-loader v1 boundary (item-id inputs only) — the row pairs stay distinguishable by their gas/molten legs, the upstream first-match-wins quirks inherit verbatim. Outputs are the bouleGt items the GTMaterialItems force-table lands (upstream OP.java:616/:619/:624).
